#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using pii = pair<int, int>;
const int INF = 100000000;
const int MAXN = 6000;

namespace mcmf {
    vector<vector<int>> adj, rev;
    vector<vector<int>> edge_cost, edge_cap;
    
    void init(int n) {
        adj.assign(n, {});
        rev.assign(n, {});
        edge_cost.assign(n, {});
        edge_cap.assign(n, {});
    }
    
    void add_edge(int x, int y, int cap, int cost) {
        rev[x].push_back(adj[y].size());
        rev[y].push_back(adj[x].size());
        adj[x].push_back(y);
        adj[y].push_back(x);
        edge_cost[x].push_back(cost);
        edge_cost[y].push_back(-cost);
        edge_cap[x].push_back(cap);
        edge_cap[y].push_back(0);
    }
    
    int dist[MAXN], vis[MAXN];
    int prex[MAXN], prei[MAXN];
    
    void spfa(int s, int n) {
        fill(dist, dist + n, 0x3f3f3f3f);
        fill(vis, vis + n, 0);
        prex[s] = -1;
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);
        dist[s] = 0;
        vis[s] = 1;
        
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int x = q.front(); q.pop();
            vis[x] = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < adj[x].size(); ++i) {
                int y = adj[x][i];
                int cc = dist[x] + edge_cost[x][i];
                if (dist[y] > cc && edge_cap[x][i]) {
                    dist[y] = cc;
                    prex[y] = x;
                    prei[y] = i;
                    if (!vis[y]) {
                        vis[y] = 1;
                        q.push(y);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    int tot = 0;
    
    int dfs(int x, int flow) {
        if (prex[x] == -1) return flow;
        int y = x;
        x = prex[y];
        int i = prei[y];
        int j = rev[x][i];
        int f = dfs(x, min(flow, edge_cap[x][i]));
        edge_cap[x][i] -= f;
        edge_cap[y][j] += f;
        return f;
    }
    
    pii solve(int s, int t, int n) {
        int ans = 0;
        tot = 0;
        while (true) {
            spfa(s, n);
            if (dist[t] > 1e9) break;
            int f = dfs(t, INF);
            tot += f * dist[t];
            ans += f;
        }
        return {ans, tot};
    }
}

int n, m, s, t;
int k, c, d;

int get(int x, int tim) {
    return tim * 52 - 52 + x;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%d%d", &n, &m, &k, &c, &d);
    int kk = k;
    
    s = MAXN - 1;
    t = MAXN - 2;
    
    while (k--) {
        int x;
        scanf("%d", &x);
        mcmf::add_edge(s, get(x, 1), 1, 0);
    }
    k = kk;
    
    while (m--) {
        int x, y;
        scanf("%d%d", &x, &y);
        for (int i = 1; i < 100; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= k; ++j) {
                mcmf::add_edge(get(x, i), get(y, i + 1), 1, d * (j + j - 1));
            }
        }
        swap(x, y);
        for (int i = 1; i < 100; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= k; ++j) {
                mcmf::add_edge(get(x, i), get(y, i + 1), 1, d * (j + j - 1));
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i < 100; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
            mcmf::add_edge(get(j, i), get(j, i + 1), INF, 0);
        }
        mcmf::add_edge(get(1, i), t, INF, c * (i - 1));
    }
    
    printf("%d", mcmf::solve(s, t, MAXN).second);
    
    return 0;
